name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace-stable
description: Stable channel of dev-digest-ai-marketplace: the last verified release of each plugin. Reusable Claude Code plugins extracted from the DevDigest harness: spec-driven workflow agents, engineering-insight logging and technical skills.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Stack skills the architecture-review and sdd-engineering plugins load: Fastify, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL table design, React, React Testing Library and Zod.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent: answers how-does-X-work questions with file:line evidence from the repo or URL evidence from official sources.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Read-only architecture reviewer agent that judges a change or plan only against the project's own documented architecture rules.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development pipeline: spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier agents, plus run-plan, workflow-retro and engineering-insights skills.
